title: lem-pc-open-extension-derived-adjunction
statement: For a scheme X and open U with the specified derived categories, let R be derived restriction to U transported across the over-site equivalence. There exist a functor J from the derived category of U to that of X and an adjunction J ⊣ R.

source.place: Tag 08BS (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open), proof: exact extension by zero; modules.tex Tag 01AK (lemma-j-shriek-exact); cohomology.tex 06YB (lemma-check-K-flat-stalks) and 06YH (definition-derived-tor)

proof.text: Specialize derived_open_shriek_adjunction to the ringed space underlying X and its open U. This gives the canonical derived extension-by-zero functor G left adjoint to F = overFunctor.mapDerivedCategory.

Let e₀ be Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U, with the explicit module categories in the statement, and let e = e₀.mapDerivedCategory. The derived equivalence has functor exactly E from the statement. Its inverse is left adjoint to its functor by e.symm.toAdjunction. Compose this adjunction with G ⊣ F using Adjunction.comp: J = e.inverse ⋙ G is left adjoint to F ⋙ E = R. Supply this J, this adjunction and True.intro. This is transport across the over-site equivalence, with no restriction-colimit or quasi-coherence argument.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08BT; transport of the existing derived extension-by-zero/restriction adjunction across the open over-site equivalence, using Equivalence.mapDerivedCategory, Equivalence.toAdjunction and Adjunction.comp.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_openExtension_derivedAdjunction (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    let E := (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ E
    ∃ J : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X,
      ∃ adj : J ⊣ R, True
